segments.name: Marketplace
segments.description: Runs global online marketplaces and mobile apps that connect buyers and sellers, earning commissions on transactions and fees from sellers' advertising.
segments.evidence: This reportable segment includes our online marketplace located at www.ebay.com and its localized counterparts, our off-platform marketplaces and our suite of mobile apps.

revenueModel.text: Buyers and sellers pay commissions, final value fees, listing and feature fees, store subscriptions and shipping fees, while sellers also pay advertising fees to promote their listings.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn revenue primarily through fees collected on paid transactions, first-party advertising and shipping.
